facts.fact: The World Bank restructuring paper says the Safety Nets Project run by NaCSA established a management information system, the SP Registry for Integrated National Targeting, and 100,695 households received regular cash transfers.

facts.fact: The World Bank says the project established an electronic payments system, with a payment service provider delivering transfers to beneficiaries.
